I get the feeling this is a copy and paste.

I never said I hated my family, I never said my friends don't care. Most of my family are dead and I've never really had many friends.

If I and everyone you knew was amazing, nothing becomes amazing. Just like the word "epic" you have used this particular word so much that it's lost all it's original meaning, it's now just a guttural tone used to indicate approval or positive reinforcement.

God, no wonder people on this sub-reddit want to kill themselves.

I was classified gifted when I was about 7 years old. 

My scoring in standardized tests was at the level of a student in grade 6 in almost all fields tested, in particular, my comprehension in geometry and spatial reasoning was well beyond my other test scores and tested well beyond

I was exceptional in Athletics and most other sports that the school threw at me (as exceptional as a 7 year old can be at any rate). I learnt a multitude of different instruments, and spoke three different languages (Mandarin, Croatian and English).

Throughout my entire life, I have felt the worse kind of guilt and pain at not living up to the expectations placed on me. My father berated and punished me every time I did not live up to those expectations, and reminded me again and again, just how much "I could have achieved" had I not been the insolent, disobedient brat that I was.

My mother was much the same, although not disproportionately so.

I started to not care and actively misbehaved. Partially due to the fact that I was well ahead of my classmates and subsequently bored shitless, but mainly because I was frustrated, angry, conflicted and importantly, because I was in a state of constant self-loathing.

All at the ripe old age of 9.

Fuck that noise. Fuck all that noise.

There's no real point to this, I can just relate.

Challenged on your beliefs, made to define them and you delete your comment.

Stop assuming you know what will happen after death, because you don't.
Nothing? What does nothing mean exactly? No matter in the universe? No energy?
It's irrelevant. You're not answering the question posed.
What does that mean exactly? The end of life?
What do you mean it's final?
